scope: Measured: local manifest lookup, file read, SHA-256 commitment check, canonical parsing/deserialization, int64 replay, checkpoint comparison, and challenge-package construction on detected faults. Projected only: ideal line-rate network transfer.
cacheCaveat: warm is page-cache eligible. fadvise requests POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED before and after each file read, but remains an advisory local-store measurement and must not be described as guaranteed device-cold I/O.
coverageInterpretation: A deterministic C1 watcher pays the full verification pipeline every round. The dispute rate q multiplies only challenge submission and any duplicated resolver work, not the observation needed to detect faults.

bootstrap.scope: Percentile-bootstrap confidence interval for the sample median of verification_ms and total_ms; deterministic seed derived from the benchmark seed and configuration.
